import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
origins=[([0,0,.333],0),([0,0,0],-np.pi/2),([0,-.316,0],np.pi/2),([.0825,0,0],np.pi/2),([-.0825,.384,0],-np.pi/2),([0,0,0],np.pi/2),([.088,0,0],np.pi/2)]
def tf(p,rot):
 t=np.eye(4);t[:3,:3]=rot;t[:3,3]=p;return t
def fk(q):
 t=tf([0,-.4,.78],R.from_euler('z',np.pi/2).as_matrix())
 for a,(p,rx) in zip(q,origins):
  t=t@tf(p,R.from_euler('x',rx).as_matrix())@tf([0,0,0],R.from_euler('z',a).as_matrix())

"""Camera-guided Panda controller. Uses only the robot client and local kinematics.
Commands and target arrays are journaled for reproducibility; no reset is used.
"""
import json, argparse
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from rcb_client import Robot
from kin import fk,ik
OUT=Path('/app/output'); r=Robot()
DOWN=np.array([[0,-1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,-1.]])
def observe(name='obs', depth=True):
 res=r.get_obs(include_depth=depth,video='none');res.save(OUT/name);return res
def move(pos=None,rot=None,finger=None,seconds=3,name='move',qtarget=None):
 obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none');p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);q=p[:7];a=p[23:32]
 if qtarget is None: qtarget=ik(np.array(pos),rot if rot is not None else DOWN,q) if pos is not None else q
 f=finger if finger is not None else a[7]
 n=int(round(seconds/.1)); target=np.r_[qtarget,f,f]
 actions=a+(target-a)*np.linspace(0,1,n)[:,None]
 with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as file: file.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'actions':actions.tolist(),'dt':.1})+'\n')
 res=r.submit('joint_position',actions,dt=.1,cameras=None,video='none',include_depth=True,note=name);res.save(OUT/name)
 print(json.dumps(res.meta));print('FK',fk(np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'])[:7])[:3,3]);return res
if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--pos',nargs=3,type=float);ap.add_argument('--quat',nargs=4,type=float);ap.add_argument('--finger',type=float);ap.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=3);ap.add_argument('--name',default='obs');ap.add_argument('--observe',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
 if args.observe: print(observe(args.name).meta)
 else: move(args.pos,R.from_quat(args.quat,scalar_first=True).as_matrix() if args.quat else None,args.finger,args.seconds,args.name)
